_comment: D.8 plugin registry. Drop a <name>.py into the plugins/ folder and add {name, enabled} here. Each plugin file defines ONE BaseModule subclass with PLUGIN_API = 1 and run(context) -> dict. Plugins are standalone commands (python main.py plugin <name> --arg k=v), never pipeline stages. See docs/PLUGINS.md. Plugins are arbitrary Python running with your user rights — only install plugins you wrote or trust.
